svg.title: ZATCA Phase-2 submission: the outbox state machine
svg.text: ZATCA Phase-2 submission: the outbox state machine
SUBMITTING is persisted BEFORE the HTTP call. Only 200, 202, 400, 401 and 403 are definitive. Everything else keeps the same UUID and the same signed bytes.

svg.text: AUTH_HOLD renews the CSID first, then resends the same bytes.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: THE THREE RULES THIS SHAPE EXISTS TO ENFORCE

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: 1. A worker killed in SUBMITTING recovers to UNKNOWN_OUTCOME, not to a new attempt.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: The tax authority may already hold the document; a new UUID would duplicate it.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: 2. invoice_hash is computed once at signing and becomes the next PIH -- whatever

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: ZATCA answers. A rejection stays in the chain; the fix is a NEW document, new ICV.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: 3. B2C (reporting) posts to the GL at sale. B2B (clearance) posts after clearance.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: Idempotency key = invoice_uuid, so accounting_postings == 1, always.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: WHAT A DEFINITIVE ANSWER MEANS

ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: Not definitive: everything else

ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: A 5xx, a gateway error, a 409 or a socket

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: timeout tells you nothing about whether

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: ZATCA processed the document. The only

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: safe move is to send the same bytes again.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: HTTP 303 is special: it means clearance is

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: deactivated for this taxpayer. The document

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: is re-sent to the REPORTING endpoint, same

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: UUID, same bytes, and a 200 there is

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: REPORTED -- which counts as acceptance for

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: a document that was issued for clearance.

ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: Genesis PIH = base64(hex(sha256("0")))

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: = NWZlY2Vi...OQ==

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: Not base64 of the raw digest. That one

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: mistake breaks every chain after it.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: TLV length is the UTF-8 BYTE length.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: Tags 1-7 are text; tags 8-9 are raw bytes.
